employment_rate_pct.src: Fox School of Business By The Numbers page

notes: Temple Fox publishes no full-time MBA class profile; the MBA is test-flexible (GMAT/GRE requested only case by case per the Temple bulletin) and the By The Numbers page reports MBA enrollment only as 390 students across full-time, part-time, online, and executive programs (Fall 2023), not a full-time class size. Salary is published only as 101,659 USD mean salary for the Full-Time MBA Class of 2023 (CSPD Report) with no median, so salary_median_usd stays null. Tuition is priced per credit and published only through the Bursar's JavaScript tuition calculator at https://bursar.temple.edu/tuition-fees/tuition-rates-tuition-calculator; no static per-credit or annual rate could be read.
